simulator.note: Boots as a 256 MB M3503 revision B chip (chips/m3503.py: uppercase BOOTLOADER / SEECODE chunk names, numeric-named 0x01FE0101 maincode chunk "113003202102162", variant 0x0001 so sys_ic_get_rev_id() returns 0x20002): runs XIP with its stack in cache-as-RAM, unpacks SEECODE (2.8 MB) to 0xAE000200 after setting 0xB8000220 bit 24 to remap physical 0x0F000000..0x0FFFFFFF to DDR, unpacks the 8.0 MB main code to 0x80000200, starts both cores (main EBase 0x80002000, SEE EBase 0x8E002001), verifies the application over SHA-256 on CryptoEngine, powers both USB ports (GPIO 72 left, GPIO 70 right; active-low overcurrent fault inputs GPIO 67 and 71 pulled up via device.gpioPullUps), and configures its second DVB-S2 demodulator (external ALi S3501 at I2C 0x33 over bit-banged GPIO I2C SCL = GPIO 6, SDA = GPIO 7; without its 0x350100C0 chip ID the NIM watchdog hides GMA layer 0 at 0xB8006300).  Draws its Polish first-install wizard "1 Wybierz język" (panel "LOC1" -> "LOC2") by ~90 M instructions (255 GE commands, 343 colours); remote DOWN and front-panel KI3/DIG4 navigate the language list (run_dump_xs65_twin_capture_screen.py).

desc: The 1.4.0 Polish retail update (140_TWIN_RETAIL_PL.abs, 2016-04-13) for the Opticum XS65 Twin dual-DVB-S2 HD satellite receiver on the 256 MB ALi M3511 / M3503 platform with 8 MB SPI flash.

Twin-satellite sibling of the Opticum XS65 Combo (140_M3515-COMBO-RETAIL-PL.abs): pairs the SoC's internal NIM_S3503_0 DVB-S2 demodulator with a second external ALi S3501 DVB-S2 demodulator at I2C 0x33 on bit-banged GPIO 6 (SCL) / GPIO 7 (SDA), monitors two USB port power switches (outputs GPIO 72 / 70, active-low fault inputs GPIO 67 / 71), and drives an FD650K 4-digit LED panel on GPIO 135 / 134.
